intro: Choose the kind of help you need. Prices are starting points; we confirm scope and final cost before work begins.

one_time.label: One-time task — from $75
one_time.text: One WordPress change, setup task or small fix. Includes request review, up to one hour of work, basic testing and a short summary. Extra work is estimated first.

content.label: Content support — $149/month
content.text: Regular text, image, page and post updates for one website. Includes up to two hours per month; technical maintenance and custom development are separate. Requests: 3–5 business days. Additional work: $70/hour. One website; unused hours do not roll over. Cancel anytime.

technical.label: Complete WordPress Care — $229/month
technical.text: Complete WordPress Care combines content updates with core, theme and plugin maintenance, backups, monitoring and basic technical checks. Includes up to two hours per month. Requests: 2–4 business days. Additional work: $70/hour. One website; unused hours do not roll over. VPS, Docker, DNS, email servers, malware removal and major development require separate review.

custom.label: Tell us what you need
custom.text: If standard options do not fit, describe your website and goals. We will review the scope and suggest a suitable plan or separate estimate.
